collection.description: A Heathen is asked to carve a tiny mask to hang over a neighbour's newborn's sleeping mat.

description_variants.description: An Isolan is asked to carve a tiny mask to hang over a neighbour's newborn's sleeping mat.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: At the camp it is the custom to carve a tiny mask for each new baby, not to wear, just to hang over the sleeping mat. (name1) has been asked to carve one for a neighbour's newborn. (He/she) spends days on it, and gives it a small, crooked smile, because the baby has one.
